name: WholeStack WF-028: Jurisdiction Source Registry Adapter

parameters.jsCode: const input=$('Webhook').first().json.body||$('Webhook').first().json; const raw=$input.first().json; let registry=raw; if(typeof raw==='string'){try{registry=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(e){registry={};}} if(raw?.data && typeof raw.data==='object') registry=raw.data; const state=String(input.state||'').trim().toUpperCase(); const county=String(input.county||'').trim().toLowerCase(); const key='US-'+state; const entry=registry?.jurisdictions?.[key]||null; const normalizeCounty=s=>String(s||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+county$/,'').replace(/\\s+/g,' '); const countyEntry=entry?.counties ? Object.entries(entry.counties).find(([name,v])=>normalizeCounty(name)===county || (Array.isArray(v?.aliases)&&v.aliases.some(a=>normalizeCounty(a)===county))) : null; const curated=[...(entry?.state_sources||[]),...((countyEntry?.[1]?.sources)||[])]; const discovered=Array.isArray(input.official_sources)?input.official_sources:[]; const seen=new Set(); const merged=[...curated,...discovered].filter(s=>{const k=String(s?.url||s?.source_record_id||s?.name||'').toLowerCase(); if(!k||seen.has(k)) return false; seen.add(k); return true;}); const blocked=merged.filter(s=>s.commercial_live_query_allowed===false); return [{json:{request_id:input.request_id||null,state,county:input.county||'',city:input.city||'',zip:input.zip||'',criteria:Array.isArray(input.criteria)?input.criteria:[],property_type:input.property_type||null,limit:input.limit||10,search_notes:input.search_notes||'',official_sources:merged.slice(0,50),curated_source_count:curated.length,discovered_source_count:discovered.length,commercial_restrictions:blocked,source_resolution:{registry_key:key,county_key:county||null,curated_match:curated.length>0,county_registry_match:Boolean(countyEntry),discovery_fallback_used:curated.length===0,registry_version:registry?.version||null,registry_source:$env.WHOLESTACK_REGISTRY_URL||'github:main/config/jurisdiction-source-registry.json',policy:'canonical provider-neutral registry; official sources first; discovery supplements unknown or incomplete jurisdictions; commercially restricted live sources are flagged rather than silently queried'}}}];
